products.title: Digital Gift Card
products.body_html:
5-Pocket or Chino? Medium or Large? Just impossible to shop for?

Don't worry - our digital gift card has you covered. They're good for all our products, they never expire, have no postage or additional processing fees, and can be sent to the recipient's inbox whenever you please. 


HOW GIFTING WORKS

  1. Enter in the lucky recipient’s name, email address, and the custom message you'd like to include in their gift card email. 
  2. Pick the date you'd like us to send their gift. It could be right now, tomorrow, or next week. Then add it to your cart. 
  3. Sit back and relax. You're done! We'll deliver the gift card straight to the recipient’s inbox on the date you selected. Once they open their gift, we'll send you an email letting you know they got it. 


NOTE: Discount codes cannot be used to purchase gift cards. LS Rewards Cash can not be redeemed on orders containing gift cards.

products.title: Eaton Packable PrimaLoft Hooded Full-Zip Jacket
products.body_html: We’re golf nuts so we’ll play golf when there’s ice on the ground (if the pro shop lets us out) and we can barely feel our fingers. That means we needed a jacket that would keep us super warm but still allowed us enough movement to make (crappy) swings. Enter the Eaton Packable PrimaLoft Hooded Full-Zip Jacket. Built with a PrimaLoft filling for the highest level of warmth and comfort, spandex side panels to allow freedom of movement, and completely packable into itself, this jacket is like a warm hug when the temps get too low or your score gets too high.

products.title: Eaton Packable PrimaLoft Hooded Full-Zip Vest
products.body_html: Pack it up and pack it in. From your golf bag to your carry on, the Eaton Packable PrimaLoft Hooded Full-Zip Vest is the perfect piece for any adventure. The wizards at PrimaLoft made a filling specifically to trap warmth and be super light at the same time. With that kind of magic on the inside, a sleek and stylish design on the outside, and a portable package, the Eaton Packable PrimaLoft Hooded Full-Zip Vest is ready for prime time.

products.title: Icon Tour 5-Pocket Performance Pant - Ellis Straight
products.body_html: The perfect complement to our popular Icon Short, the Icon Tour 5-Pocket pant contains the same amazing fabrication but in a pant. products.title: Bandon Quarter Snap Layer
products.body_html:
The Bandon Quarter Snap Layer is basically the MVP of cold-weather gear. It’s got the cozy warmth of a fleece jacket with the "I could totally wear this anywhere" vibe of a sweater. Featuring an interior double face lining (translation: it’s ridiculously soft) and just enough stretch to keep you moving without that awkward tug.
